transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?

Just... having some trouble at work, I guess. Um, like I'll start a safety briefing or a plan review, and I try hard to pay attention to it. But within minutes, my mind is just off on three other job problems. I end up missing things I know I should have caught. So... that's why I'm here.
Do you have similar problems focusing or staying on task in other parts of your life, like at home or during conversations?

Yeah... I guess so. Conversations, mostly. Like, my foreman will be talking straight to me, or... my wife. And I'm looking right at them, but... I just end up having to tell them to run that by me again. I usually only catch the last few words.
Do you find yourself getting distracted easily or forgetting things often, even when you're trying to focus?
I mean... yeah, I guess. Like I just said with the work stuff. But... forgetting things? I don't really know. I haven't really noticed. I just... get sidetracked, I guess.
Do you find that these distractions and difficulties staying focused happen in other places besides work, like at home, in social situations, or when you're trying to relax?

Uh... I don't really know. I haven't really paid much attention to it outside of the job. At home, I just... I don't know, try to watch TV or whatever. I haven't really thought about it. Mostly it's just the work stuff that's the issue.
Can you think of any times outside of work, like at home or in social situations, where you’ve had trouble focusing or felt easily distracted?
I mean... not really. I don't know. Like I said, I mostly just try to unwind when I get home. I guess maybe sometimes I don't catch everything my wife says, but... I don't really keep track of it.
Do you often feel restless or find yourself needing to be constantly active, even in situations where you're expected to sit still or stay quiet?

I guess... yeah, maybe. I don't know if it's constantly active, but... sitting still is hard. Like, in meetings and stuff. Everyone else just sits there the whole time, and... I can't. I'm always the guy getting up. I'll go get coffee, or... step outside to check on something. I just... I make up reasons to move around. I don't really like just sitting there.
Looking back, did you have similar issues with focusing or staying still when you were younger, like in school or when you were a kid?

Yeah... I guess. It goes pretty far back. Like, even in elementary school, my teachers were already telling my parents about it. Said I couldn't stay in my seat, or... I'd talk out of turn. Stuff like that. I was always losing my homework, too. And... I don't know, they said I'd just rush through directions before I really understood what I was supposed to be doing. So... yeah. Same kind of stuff.
